title: The Maximal Graph - Wilker Silva
summary: A Clojure/conj 2019 talk by Wilker Silva on how namespace-qualified keywords and context-free federated names can be used pragmatically for data modeling, drawn from his experience at Nubank. It builds toward a graph-based view of connecting data from many sources.
why: Cited as a demonstration of the Pathom/graph approach to connecting APIs, as an alternative to GraphQL.

quote.text: Just watch the last part of Wilker Silva's The Maximal Graph talk to see the potential
